sb_prompt: FIND OUT FROM THE OTHER CALLER WHAT KIND OF CAMPING THEY HAVE DONE.  HOW DOES IT COMPARE WITH YOUR OWN EXPERIENCES?
turns: So, what kind of camping have you done?

I enjoyed the idea of being more immersed in nature, but the physical demands of carrying all of my gear on my back was quite challenging for me. It's impressive that you've done both! What's your preferred way to camp?
